libs.note: BH-5520. The merge conductor's fast parent merge: a stacked child whose parent row is QUEUED on its reviewed head, and which is itself APPROVE on its head, green and clean on a merge_method=merge repo, is retargeted to the project base and enqueued behind the parent in the same tick. A parent that leaves the queue unmerged revokes it (dequeue, base moved back). Applied by the lib at file scope, in a subshell; the code literal after the read is the documented fallback when there is no registry.

knobs.zero_means: a stacked child waits STACKED_WAIT until its parent merges (pre-BH-5520)
knobs.note: 1 lets a stacked child of a QUEUED parent retarget to the project base and enqueue behind the parent in the same tick. Marks already written are still revoked when their parent leaves the queue.

How long a stack-fast mark (state/merge-conductor/stack-fast/<slug>#<num>) is kept before msf_sweep drops it. Longer than any batch lifetime, so only marks whose child or parent finished long ago are dropped.
